The remote illusion: this file is what makes a frontend requirement impossible to delete quietly - a removed suite, a removed headline journey, a shrunk corpus or a disabled test all fail the gate instead of passing it with less evidence.

B1-B3 P9 management surface in the browser
B4/B5/B6 real provider turn, app restart, operability floor and the frontend criteria

requiredTitles: conformance: chat surface meets the frontend criteria
conformance: management surface meets the frontend criteria

reference browser mounts the reference surface with live SSE and cookie reload
